ml_experiment.conclusion: On held-out weeks the Poisson model's MAE is 2.8 vs 2.79 for the ewma_0.3 baseline (not lower; this baseline was chosen on the training weeks only, so it can differ from the one used for the live estimates). This is synthetic data, so it shows the pipeline works, not that the model is better for real communities. The planner keeps using the transparent baseline; the model stays experimental.
